title: Where the Tide Turns
style: Soft rock power ballad, intimate piano opening with restrained clean electric guitar and warm bass, steady spacious drums entering gradually; verse lines trade between a thoughtful male tenor and a clear female mezzo, then join in close harmony on a broad emotional chorus. Build with sustained electric guitar, subtle strings, and fuller drums into a powerful final chorus, then resolve gently. Natural, expressive vocal performances, polished but warm studio mix, narrative storytelling, standard American English.
lyrics:
[Verse 1: Female]
You came back from Worcester with the salt in your hair
Your bags by the doorway, your thoughts somewhere else
You asked how my father was; I said, “He’s better”
Then you asked me to walk where the tide meets the land

[Verse 2: Male]
The house held its breath as we crossed the old bridge
Past the gate and the path, down to heat in the sand
I took off my sandals; you followed my lead
With the waves at our ankles, you asked me to speak

[Pre-Chorus: Female]
You said you weren’t broken, just tired from the days
The opening, the tremors, the plans and the weight
You reached for a word, but the wind took it away

[Chorus: Both]
You are more than the work that the world gives your hands
More than the roads and the lines in the sand
You’re still the one who can dream past the shore
And I’ll walk beside you, whatever comes next
When you can’t find the words, I’ll be here
When the tide turns, I’ll be here

[Verse 3: Male]
“I’ve been writing a novel,” I said to the sea
“It’s the one thing that’s taking all of me lately”
You watched my face, letting silence unfold
Like you knew there was more than the story I told

[Verse 4: Female]
They know how you vanish when something takes hold
How the hours run fast and the outside grows small
They didn’t call me to pull you away
They called because they knew what you wouldn’t say

[Pre-Chorus: Both]
You don’t have to name every turn of the road
You don’t have to carry the whole thing alone
There’s room for the dream and the life that you know

[Chorus: Both]
You are more than the work that the world gives your hands
More than the roads and the lines in the sand
You’re still the one who can dream past the shore
And I’ll walk beside you, whatever comes next
When you can’t find the words, I’ll be here
When the tide turns, I’ll be here

[Bridge: Female, then Male]
[F]
The wind pulled your answer out over the water
[M]
The waves brought it back in a shape I could hold
[F]
You’re allowed to become someone new in the quiet
[M]
And still be the person I’ve always known

[Final Chorus: Both]
You are more than the work that the world gives your hands
More than the plans that keep shifting like sand
You’re still the one who can dream past the shore
And I’ll walk beside you, whatever comes next
When you can’t find the words, I’ll be here
Through the long days, I’ll be here
When the tide turns, I’ll be here

[Outro: Both]
I’ll be here
Where the tide turns
I’ll be here
